disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV depression patients from two independent Chinese institutional datasets (discovery: 105 never-treated first-episode patients; replication: 106 patients). Total clinical cohort N=211.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "297 patients with depression and 256 healthy controls (HCs) from two independent Chinese dataset were included: a discovery dataset (105 never-treated first-episode patients and matched 130 HCs) and a replication dataset (106 patients and matched 126 HCs)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Discovery dataset: First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University (single institutional site). Replication dataset: Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute / University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (single institutional site). Both are Chinese in-house datasets with no registered public dataset names.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 never-treated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University." "In the replication dataset, 106 patients with depression were recruited from the Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from two datasets. Discovery: N=105, mean=20.30, SD=5.04. Replication: N=106, mean=33.27, SD=12.26. Weighted mean=(105×20.30+106×33.27)/211=26.82. Pooled SD=sqrt((104×5.04²+105×12.26²)/209)=9.39. Min/max not reported.

sex.detail: Paper reports male % only; absolute counts derived by calculation. Discovery: 50.48%×105=53 males, 52 females. Replication: 44.34%×106=47 males, 59 females. Combined: male=100/211=47.4%, female=111/211=52.6%. Counts are estimated from reported percentages.
